I have some schooling so I can read the labels at the cooperative, but for this small bean plot I do what my family has always done. I will put compost from our animals on this land because I own it and want to keep the soil fertile, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer — one bag is far too much for 0.06 hectares and I don't have money to share a bag with neighbors this season. I will plant local bean seed I saved from last year, and I won't use any sprays or irrigation since we depend on the meher rains. My family and I will manage all the work ourselves, about 12 days over the season, and I will not hire any outside labor.
